mapper.select:
select efa.*, pp.P_Name as projectName,gfp.Gfp_Year AS efaGfpYear,gfp.Gfp_Month AS efaGfpMonth, pp.P_Inv_Total as pInvTotal, pp.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget from Engineering_Fund_Application efa left join Group_Fund_Plan gfp on efa.Efa_Gfp_Id = gfp.id left join Pre_Project pp on efa.P_ID = pp.P_ID
efa.state !=3
and likePname(#{params.projectName},pp.P_Id)=true
and pp.P_Name like concat('%',#{params.projectName},'%')
and efa.P_ID = #{params.projectId}

select efabd.*, bai.Account_Type as accountType, case bai.Account_Type when '01' then bai.Ba_Company_ID when '02' then bai.Ba_Digital_RMB_Company_ID end as companyID, case bai.Account_Type when '01' then sd.D_Name when '02' then sc2.C_Name end as companyName, case bai.Account_Type when '01' then bai.Ba_Bank_Name when '02' then bai.Ba_Digital_RMB_Bank_Name end as bankName, case bai.Account_Type when '01' then bai.Ba_Bank_Account when '02' then bai.Ba_Digital_RMB_Account end as bankAccount from Engineering_Fund_Application_Bank_Detail efabd left join Bank_Account_Info bai on efabd.Ba_Id = bai.id left join SYS_Department sd on bai.ba_company_id = sd.D_ID left join SYS_Company sc2 on bai.ba_digital_rmb_company_id = sc2.C_ID where efabd.Efa_Id = #{id}

select efa.*, pp.P_Name as projectName,gfp.Gfp_Year AS efaGfpYear,gfp.Gfp_Month AS efaGfpMonth, pp.P_Inv_Total as pInvTotal, pp.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, dh.Dh_Code as pDhCode, dh2.Dh_Code as uDhAccount, dh3.Dh_Code as dDhCode, dh4.Dh_Code as dDhCodeLD from Engineering_Fund_Application efa left join Group_Fund_Plan gfp on efa.Efa_Gfp_Id = gfp.id left join Pre_Project pp on efa.P_ID = pp.P_ID left join Dh_Data dh on pp.P_ID = dh.P_Id and dh.State=7 and dh.Dh_Type='项目信息' left join Dh_Data dh2 on efa.Efa_User_Id = dh2.U_Id and dh2.State=7 and dh2.Dh_Type='人员信息' left join Dh_Data dh3 on efa.Efa_Department_Name = dh3.D_Name and dh3.State=7 and dh3.Dh_Type='部门信息' left join Dh_Data dh4 on efa.Efa_Leader_Id = dh4.U_Id and dh4.State=7 and dh4.Dh_Type='人员信息' where efa.id = #{id}

select efa.*, pp.P_Name as projectName,gfp.Gfp_Year AS efaGfpYear,gfp.Gfp_Month AS efaGfpMonth, pp.P_Inv_Total as pInvTotal, pp.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, dh.Dh_Code as pDhCode, dh2.Dh_Code as uDhAccount, dh3.Dh_Code as dDhCode, dh4.Dh_Code as dDhCodeLD from Engineering_Fund_Application efa left join Group_Fund_Plan gfp on efa.Efa_Gfp_Id = gfp.id left join Pre_Project pp on efa.P_ID = pp.P_ID left join Dh_Data dh on pp.P_ID = dh.P_Id and dh.State=7 and dh.Dh_Type='项目信息' left join Dh_Data dh2 on efa.Efa_User_Id = dh2.U_Id and dh2.State=7 and dh2.Dh_Type='人员信息' left join Dh_Data dh3 on efa.Efa_Department_Name = dh3.D_Name and dh3.State=7 and dh3.Dh_Type='部门信息' left join Dh_Data dh4 on efa.Efa_Leader_Id = dh4.U_Id and dh4.State=7 and dh4.Dh_Type='人员信息' where efa.id in
#{id}

select dh.Dh_Code as DhCode from Dh_Data dh where dh.State=7 and Dh_Type='银行账户信息' and dh.P_Id = #{pId} and dh.Bank_Account = #{account} and dh.Account_Type = #{type} order by dh.State_Time desc limit 1
